en: Monochrome vintage postcard showing a grand Baroque-style fountain set against the facade of a palace with large Corinthian columns and rich sculptural decoration. The fountain features a central standing male figure in historical dress on a rocky base, surrounded by hunting dogs, game, and several other figures arranged on multiple levels, with water cascading into a circular basin in the foreground. The architecture behind has a domed roof, balustrades, and ornate reliefs.
